description: Holds 100 polyphonic gate patterns of up to sixteen gates each, with the pattern picked by voltage

params.text: Picks which of the 100 patterns is played and edited
While on, the pattern is picked by hand and a cable in the pattern input no longer moves the selection
Copies the gates of the current pattern
Writes the copied gates into the current pattern
Pushes the patterns after the current one along by one place and empties the current one; the hundredth pattern is lost
Removes the current pattern and pulls every later pattern back one place

inputs.text: Selects the pattern, 0.1V per pattern over 0-10V; while it is patched the pattern cannot be picked by hand unless Edit is on

outputs.text: Carries the current pattern, 10V on the channel of each gate that is on and 0V on the rest, with the channel count set in the menu

notes: every one of the 100 patterns comes up empty, so no gate is on and the output stays at 0V until squares are clicked on in the grid or a randomise fills them
clicking a square in the gate grid switches that gate of the current pattern on or off
menu: Polyphonic Channels — sets how many gates a pattern holds, 1 to 16
Random — opens a density slider that sets how many gates a randomise switches on; randomising changes the current pattern only
Count from zero — numbers the gates in the grid from zero in place of one
Round pattern input — rounds the voltage at the pattern input to the nearest pattern in place of truncating it
